title: Anonymous fortune500 static chat win

change.control: Paid-search free-trial landing page with timed chat popup, lead form and phone number.
change.variant: Replace timed popup with a clickable static chat-box image, add contact-value copy and move lead form lower.

significance.reported: 99% level of confidence for chat-click increase.

quote: The treatment resulted in a dramatic lift of 120.60% in chat clicks over the control at a 99% level of confidence.
notes: Primary test goal was chat clicks. Form submissions fell 60.54% at 99% confidence and phone calls fell 33.64% at 89% confidence. Projected annual revenue increase was modeled, not observed. Business category reflects the lead-capture objective; specific industry undisclosed.
